name: Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero - Randomizer
summary:
Rediscover Sub-Zero’s journey like never before!

This mod completely shuffles the item distribution in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero, delivering a fresh and challenging experience for both veterans and newcomers. Power-ups, keys, and essential items are now placed at random, putting your knowledge and adaptability to the ultimate test.

In addition, the randomizer grants immediate access to all levels from the start, allowing for a non-linear playthrough. The experience requirements to complete the game have also been adjusted, making progression more flexible and suited to the randomized structure.
